item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be fine and dry over Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will remain cool in the morning over the coastal areas, and it will be cold over inland areas. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region.
